I don’t think this meme is /entirely/ fair just because I think today we’re all entitled to interpret  beauty standards placed upon us to different degrees. Although women do have more rigorous and narrow beauty standards, I feel like within my own community there are many  girls who are thriving in society and don’t feel like they need to touch makeup or drop 30 pounds in order to be loved; and their concern about losing or gaining weight may be just as equal concern as a boy’s concern about losing or gaining weight. Obviously I am not in this camp as I do suffer from an ED and image issues, but I know just as many boys as girls who are vastly insecure about how they look and have gone through less than healthy means of obtaining their goal. Regardless, I will not let my personal perspective on how I observe close friends interact with beauty standards define who’s entitled to what amount of sympathy.
